title: rubus pallidus subsp. curvistylus
intro: Rubus pallidus subsp. curvistylus, commonly known as a type of bramble, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Rubus pallidus subsp. curvistylus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, anti-cancer effects, and cardiovascular protection. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce oxidative stress and inflammation in the body.
